acceptable_paraphrases: Congruent shapes have equal sides and angles
critical_errors: incorrect plural forms like side/s or angle/s
misconceptions: sides and angles are not the same
only one set of corresponding parts is mentioned (e.g., just sides or just angles)
shapes with different number of sides can be congruent
grading_notes: Credit should be given for any variation that accurately conveys 'corresponding' or 'equal'. Misconceptions listed are common pitfalls and will result in no credit.
